column1: # Tools of the module, one wrapper (system/bin/NAME) per row, in module order (origins.txt, MANIFEST.json).
# Every tool must be built by its recipe; stage.py fails otherwise.
# name(- = libexec only)  recipe  binary(.work/ndk/out/bin = libexec name)  args(- = none)  flags(- = none; dns = needs a DNS server address,
# not getaddrinfo: the wrapper adds @<server>; dnsenv = the wrapper exports ALT_DNS_SERVERS for BIND's dig/host and nmap's reverse DNS)
